```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tibble)
library(writexl)
install.packages("fingertipsR")

project_dir <- "C:/Users/ranve/Documents/Bioinformatics/Individual project"

clean <- function(x) {
  stringr::str_squish(as.character(x))
}

num <- function(x) {
  suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub(",", "", clean(x))))
}

targets <- tibble::tribble(
  ~LAD24CD,               ~LAD24NM,
  "E06000027",            "Torbay",
  "E06000046",            "Isle of Wight",
  "E06000052, E06000053", "Cornwall and Isles of Scilly",
  "E06000063",            "Cumberland",
  "E06000064",            "Westmorland and Furness",
  "E06000065",            "North Yorkshire",
  "E06000066",            "Somerset",
  "E08000016",            "Barnsley",
  "E08000019",            "Sheffield",
  "E09000001",            "City of London"
)

code_map <- c(
  "E06000027" = "E06000027",
  "E06000046" = "E06000046",
  "E06000052" = "E06000052, E06000053",
  "E06000053" = "E06000052, E06000053",
  "E06000063" = "E06000063",
  "E06000064" = "E06000064",
  "E06000065" = "E06000065",
  "E06000066" = "E06000066",
  "E08000016" = "E08000016",
  "E08000019" = "E08000019",
  "E09000001" = "E09000001"
)

name_map <- c(
  "torbay" = "E06000027",
  "isle of wight" = "E06000046",
  "cornwall" = "E06000052, E06000053",
  "isles of scilly" = "E06000052, E06000053",
  "cornwall and isles of scilly" = "E06000052, E06000053",
  "cumberland" = "E06000063",
  "allerdale" = "E06000063",
  "carlisle" = "E06000063",
  "copeland" = "E06000063",
  "westmorland and furness" = "E06000064",
  "barrow in furness" = "E06000064",
  "barrow-in-furness" = "E06000064",
  "eden" = "E06000064",
  "south lakeland" = "E06000064",
  "north yorkshire" = "E06000065",
  "craven" = "E06000065",
  "hambleton" = "E06000065",
  "harrogate" = "E06000065",
  "richmondshire" = "E06000065",
  "ryedale" = "E06000065",
  "scarborough" = "E06000065",
  "selby" = "E06000065",
  "somerset" = "E06000066",
  "mendip" = "E06000066",
  "sedgemoor" = "E06000066",
  "somerset west and taunton" = "E06000066",
  "south somerset" = "E06000066",
  "barnsley" = "E08000016",
  "sheffield" = "E08000019",
  "city of london" = "E09000001"
)

map_area <- function(code, name) {
  code <- toupper(gsub("\\s+", "", clean(code)))
  name <- stringr::str_to_lower(clean(name))

  result <- unname(code_map[code])
  missing <- is.na(result)
  result[missing] <- unname(name_map[name[missing]])

  result
}

#Births and stillbirths

births_raw <- readxl::read_excel(
  file.path(project_dir, "only_birth.xlsx"),
  sheet = "Sheet1"
)

births_mapped <- births_raw %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    source_code = clean(`Area of usual residence \r\nCode`),
    source_name = clean(`Area of usual residence \r\nName`),
    maternal_age_group = clean(`Age of Mother at birth (years)`),
    live_births = num(`Number of live births`),
    stillbirths = num(`Number of stillbirths`),
    LAD24CD = map_area(source_code, source_name)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(LAD24CD))

birth_totals <- births_mapped %>%
  dplyr::filter(maternal_age_group == "All ages") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(LAD24CD) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    live_births = sum(live_births, na.rm = TRUE),
    stillbirths = sum(stillbirths, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#Ethnicity

ethnicity_raw <- readxl::read_excel(
  file.path(project_dir, "ethnicities.xlsx"),
  sheet = "Dataset"
)

ethnicity_source <- ethnicity_raw %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    source_name = clean(`Lower Tier Local Authorities`),
    ethnic_group = clean(`Ethnic Group (detailed) (288 categories)`),
    population = num(Observation),
    LAD24CD = map_area(
      rep(NA_character_, dplyr::n()),
      source_name
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(LAD24CD),
    !stringr::str_detect(
      stringr::str_to_lower(ethnic_group),
      "does not apply"
    )
  )

ethnicity <- ethnicity_source %>%
  dplyr::group_by(LAD24CD) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    census_population = sum(population, na.rm = TRUE),
    white_british_population = sum(
      population[
        stringr::str_detect(
          ethnic_group,
          stringr::regex(
            "^White:\\s*English, Welsh, Scottish, Northern Irish or British$",
            ignore_case = TRUE
          )
        )
      ],
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    ethnic_minority_pct = dplyr::if_else(
      census_population > 0,
      100 * (census_population - white_british_population) /
        census_population,
      NA_real_
    )
  )

#IMD

imd_raw <- readxl::read_excel(
  file.path(
    project_dir,
    "File_1_IoD2025 Index of Multiple Deprivation.xlsx"
  ),
  sheet = "IMD25"
)

imd <- imd_raw %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    source_code = clean(`Local Authority District code (2024)`),
    source_name = clean(`Local Authority District name (2024)`),
    LAD24CD = map_area(source_code, source_name),
    imd_rank = num(
      `Index of Multiple Deprivation (IMD) Rank (where 1 is most deprived)`
    ),
    imd_decile = num(
      `Index of Multiple Deprivation (IMD) Decile (where 1 is most deprived 10% of LSOAs)`
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(LAD24CD)) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(LAD24CD) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_lsoa_imd_rank = mean(imd_rank, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_lsoa_imd_rank = median(imd_rank, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_lsoa_imd_decile = mean(imd_decile, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_lsoas = sum(!is.na(imd_rank)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#Fingertips data

get_indicator <- function(id, output_name) {

  dat <- fingertipsR::fingertips_data(
    IndicatorID = id,
    AreaTypeID = 501
  )

  if (nrow(dat) == 0) {
    return(
      tibble::tibble(LAD24CD = character(), value = numeric()) %>%
        dplyr::rename(!!output_name := value)
    )
  }

  area_code_col <- intersect(c("AreaCode", "Area Code"), names(dat))[1]
  area_name_col <- intersect(c("AreaName", "Area Name"), names(dat))[1]

  if (is.na(area_code_col) || !"Value" %in% names(dat)) {
    stop(paste("Unexpected Fingertips columns for indicator", id))
  }

  area_name <- if (!is.na(area_name_col)) {
    clean(dat[[area_name_col]])
  } else {
    rep(NA_character_, nrow(dat))
  }

  period_order <- if ("TimeperiodSort" %in% names(dat)) {
    num(dat[["TimeperiodSort"]])
  } else if ("Timeperiod" %in% names(dat)) {
    num(stringr::str_extract(as.character(dat[["Timeperiod"]]), "\\d{4}"))
  } else {
    rep(0, nrow(dat))
  }

  dat %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      LAD24CD = map_area(dat[[area_code_col]], area_name),
      value = num(.data[["Value"]]),
      period_order = period_order
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(LAD24CD), !is.na(value)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(LAD24CD) %>%
    dplyr::slice_max(
      order_by = period_order,
      n = 1,
      with_ties = FALSE
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(LAD24CD, value) %>%
    dplyr::rename(!!output_name := value)
}

get_maternal_age_35plus <- function() {

  dat <- fingertipsR::fingertips_data(
    IndicatorID = 92250,
    AreaTypeID = 501
  )

  area_code_col <- intersect(c("AreaCode", "Area Code"), names(dat))[1]
  area_name_col <- intersect(c("AreaName", "Area Name"), names(dat))[1]

  area_name <- if (!is.na(area_name_col)) {
    clean(dat[[area_name_col]])
  } else {
    rep(NA_character_, nrow(dat))
  }

  period_order <- if ("TimeperiodSort" %in% names(dat)) {
    num(dat[["TimeperiodSort"]])
  } else if ("Timeperiod" %in% names(dat)) {
    num(stringr::str_extract(as.character(dat[["Timeperiod"]]), "\\d{4}"))
  } else {
    rep(0, nrow(dat))
  }

  dat %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      LAD24CD = map_area(dat[[area_code_col]], area_name),
      maternal_age_35plus_count = num(.data[["Count"]]),
      period_order = period_order
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(LAD24CD)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(LAD24CD) %>%
    dplyr::slice_max(
      order_by = period_order,
      n = 1,
      with_ties = FALSE
    ) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(LAD24CD, maternal_age_35plus_count)
}

maternal_age_data <- get_maternal_age_35plus() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    maternal_age_35plus_count = dplyr::case_when(
      LAD24CD == "E06000027" ~ 217,
      LAD24CD == "E09000001" ~ 39,
      TRUE ~ maternal_age_35plus_count
    )
  )

smoking <- get_indicator(93085, "smoking_at_delivery_value") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    smoking_at_delivery_value = dplyr::if_else(
      LAD24CD == "E09000001",
      5.4,
      smoking_at_delivery_value
    )
  )

obesity <- get_indicator(93881, "obesity_value")

#Combine missing LAD data

final_data <- targets %>%
  dplyr::left_join(birth_totals, by = "LAD24CD") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(maternal_age_data, by = "LAD24CD") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(ethnicity, by = "LAD24CD") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(imd, by = "LAD24CD") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(obesity, by = "LAD24CD") %>%
  dplyr::left_join(smoking, by = "LAD24CD") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    smoking_at_delivery_value = dplyr::if_else(
      LAD24CD == "E09000001",
      5.4,
      smoking_at_delivery_value
    ),
    stillbirth_rate_per_1000 = dplyr::if_else(
      !is.na(live_births) & live_births > 0,
      1000 * stillbirths / live_births,
      NA_real_
    )
  )

#Missing data report

missing_report <- final_data %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    LAD24CD,
    LAD24NM,
    missing_live_births = is.na(live_births),
    missing_stillbirths = is.na(stillbirths),
    missing_maternal_age_35plus_count = is.na(maternal_age_35plus_count),
    missing_ethnicity = is.na(ethnic_minority_pct),
    missing_imd = is.na(mean_lsoa_imd_rank),
    missing_obesity = is.na(obesity_value),
    missing_smoking = is.na(smoking_at_delivery_value)
  )

print(final_data, n = Inf)
print(missing_report, n = Inf)

#Save file
writexl::write_xlsx(
  list(
    Final_Data = final_data,
    Missing_Data = missing_report,
    Ethnicity_Check = ethnicity,
    Births_Check = birth_totals,
    Maternal_Age_Check = maternal_age_data,
    IMD_Check = imd
  ),
  path = file.path(project_dir, "LADs_all_data.xlsx")
)
```
